cast.title: Scream VI
cast.overview: Following the latest Ghostface killings, the four survivors leave Woodsboro behind and start a fresh chapter.

cast.title: Bella
cast.overview: During a 1980s crime wave, a cop’s daughter goes on a rampage to unearth her father’s attempted assassin and weed out deep-rooted corruption in the New York City Police Department.

cast.title: Eenie Meanie
cast.overview: A former teenage getaway driver gets dragged back into her unsavory past when a former employer offers her a chance to save the life of her chronically unreliable ex-boyfriend.

cast.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
cast.overview: Down the Rabbit Hole looks beyond the polished facade of the Playboy brand to depict the visceral, often deeply damaging stories of the women who entered following a dream and found themselves manipulated, controlled, and abused by the machine.

cast.title: 200% Wolf
cast.overview: When Freddy Lupin's wayward wish transforms him into a werewolf and deposits a mischievous moon sprite on Earth, Freddy must restore the cosmic order before the earth and moon collide.

cast.title: Borderline
cast.overview: After escaping from a mental hospital, a violent sociopath named Paul begins a dangerous rampage targeting Sofia, a world-famous pop star. Obsessed with her, he takes Sofia hostage in her own home, acting under the delusional belief that they are getting married. Paul is desperate to prove his devotion, leading to a tense and unpredictable situation.

cast.title: Mystery Road
cast.overview: A murdered girl is found under a bridge on a remote road and indigenous detective Jay Swan gets the case. Jay finds that no-one is that interested in solving the murder of an indigenous teenager and he is forced to work alone.

cast.title: Azrael
cast.overview: In a world where no one speaks, a devout female hunts down a young woman who has escaped her imprisonment. Recaptured by its ruthless leaders, Azrael is due to be sacrificed to pacify an ancient evil deep within the surrounding wilderness.

cast.title: La Snob
cast.overview: Set in 1542, Marguerite de La Rocque was judged and labeled by the French aristocracy as a snob, but after she is stranded on The Isle of Demons, Marguerite breaks free of the stereotypes that have defined her. Based on a real woman who became a legend.

cast.title: Babylon
cast.overview: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, tracing the rise and fall of multiple characters in an era of unbridled decadence and depravity during Hollywood's transition from silent films to sound films in the late 1920s.

cast.title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
cast.original_title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
cast.overview: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

cast.title: Sprung
cast.overview: A young girl's imagination takes over after stumbling across a mysterious black bag.

cast.title: Bad Girl
cast.overview: Bad girl Amy is given one last chance by her adoptive parents, who think her friendship with local girl Chloe is a step in the right direction. But when Amy discovers that Chloe harbors a dark secret, she finds herself fighting for her life.

cast.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cast.overview: After seven months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at Bill Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command Officer Jason Dixon, an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence, gets involved, the battle between Mildred and Ebbing's law enforcement is only exacerbated.

cast.title: Carolina Caroline
cast.overview: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

cast.title: Mayhem
cast.overview: A virus spreads through an office complex, causing white-collar workers to act out their worst impulses.

cast.title: Monster Trucks
cast.overview: Tripp is a high school senior with a knack for building trucks who makes an incredible discovery - a gas-guzzling creature named Creech. To protect his mischievous new friend, Tripp hides Creech under the hood of his latest creation, turning it into a real-life super-powered Monster Truck. Together, this unlikely duo with a shared taste for speed team up on a wild and unforgettable journey to reunite Creech with his family.

cast.title: Growing Young
cast.overview: Minks, 16, is living with her Nan who has dementia. Unaware of what Dementia really is, Minks is trying to understand the severity of her Nan’s forgetfulness. The two women share a unique bond, despite their generational gap, which is highlighted by Nan’s good sense of humour. However it’s only a matter of time till Minks is forced to realise she can no longer care for her Nan on her own.

cast.title: Guns Akimbo
cast.overview: An ordinary guy suddenly finds himself forced to fight a gladiator-like battle for a dark website that streams the violence for viewers. In order to survive and rescue his kidnapped ex-girlfriend, he must battle Nix, a heavily armed and much more experienced fighter.

cast.title: Last Moment of Clarity
cast.overview: After his girlfriend Georgia is murdered by European mobsters, Sam flees to Paris to hide out. Years later, he sees a woman in a Hollywood film who he's certain is Georgia. In L.A. to investigate, he encounters Kat who impulsively decides to help him on his quest. But when Sam meets the mystery actress face to face his life spins out of control.

cast.title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
cast.overview: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged Bill and Ted who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

cast.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
cast.overview: After saving the life of their heir apparent, tenacious loner Snake Eyes is welcomed into an ancient Japanese clan called the Arashikage where he is taught the ways of the ninja warrior. But, when secrets from his past are revealed, Snake Eyes' honor and allegiance will be tested – even if that means losing the trust of those closest to him.

cast.title: Ready or Not
cast.overview: A young bride's wedding night turns into her worst nightmare when her ridiculously rich in-laws force her to play a gruesome game of hide-and-seek.

cast.title: 100% Wolf
cast.overview: Freddy Lupin, heir to a proud family line of werewolves, is in for a shock when on his 14th birthday his first 'warfing' goes awry, turning him into a ferocious poodle.  The pack elders give Freddy until the next moonrise to prove he has the heart of a wolf, or risk being cast out forever.  With the help of an unlikely ally in a streetwise stray named Batty, Freddy must prove he's 100% Wolf.

cast.title: The Babysitter: Killer Queen
cast.overview: Two years after defeating a satanic cult led by his babysitter Bee, Cole's trying to forget his past and focus on surviving high school. But when old enemies unexpectedly return, Cole will once again have to outsmart the forces of evil.

cast.title: Liz
cast.overview: A biopic about one of America's founding mothers Elizabeth Patterson Bonaparte.

cast.title: The Valet
cast.overview: World famous movie star Olivia faces a PR disaster when a paparazzi snaps a photo of her with her married lover, Vincent. The hard-working valet Antonio accidentally appears in the same photo and is enlisted to pose as Olivia’s new boyfriend as a cover-up. This ruse with Olivia thrusts Antonio into the spotlight and unexpected chaos.

cast.title: The Babysitter
cast.overview: When Cole stays up past his bedtime, he discovers that his hot babysitter is part of a Satanic cult that will stop at nothing to keep him quiet.

cast.title: Chevalier
cast.overview: The illegitimate son of an African slave and a French plantation owner, Joseph Bologne rises to improbable heights in French society as a celebrated violinist-composer and fencer, complete with an ill-fated love affair and a falling out with Marie Antoinette and her court.

cast.title: Over Your Dead Body
cast.overview: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to "reconnect", but each has secret intentions to kill the other.

cast.title: Dickhead
cast.overview: A short film about a young man who simply wants the attention of his paramour.

cast.title: Untitled X-Men Film
cast.overview: A film set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) based on the Marvel Comics team. Plot TBA.

cast.title: Hivemind
cast.overview: An environmental thriller about the evolution of a new breed of killer wasps and the small town authorities who team up to prevent a deadly global outbreak.

cast.title: The Legend of Zelda
cast.overview: A live-action adaptation of Nintendo's Legend of Zelda video game series.

cast.title: Let the Games Begin: The Making of Ready or Not
cast.original_title: Let the Games Begin: The Making of Ready or Not
cast.overview: A multi-part, behind-the-scenes documentary chronicling the making of 2019's Ready or Not.

cast.title: Naughty
cast.overview: To secure custody of her son from her ex, Mallory's only hope is to find Santa Claus and convince him to testify in her divorce hearing.
